title: 真实TLS-PSK身份与密钥双重匹配：使用已验证TLS构建，拒绝明文降级且保留原Agent限制
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: identity用于选择密钥身份，PSK是认证材料，任一不匹配都会握手失败。
两侧加密模式也需一致；排障记录identity可按策略脱敏，绝不输出PSK明文。

conversion.original_title: PSK identity与PSK值为什么都要匹配？

body:
## 操作任务
实现configure_psk(settings,identity,psk_file)，深拷贝后仅设置TLSAccept=psk、TLSPSKIdentity、TLSPSKFile，保留Server/Hostname及其余参数。identity为1..64位字母数字/点/下划线/连字符，首位字母数字。PSK路径先lstat确认是当前owner私有、组/others无权限的普通文件，再读取ASCII去首尾空白后恰64位十六进制；软链接、FIFO等非普通文件必须在读取前拒绝，非法输入ValueError，不改文件、权限或生成替代密钥。真实官方Debian构建Agent7.0.32编译含OpenSSL，实际TLS1.2 PSK只有identity和key同时匹配才agent.ping=1；错误identity、错误key和明文均不能成功，拒绝探针后再验证批准访问仍正常。先前官方静态构建不含TLS的失败实验仍不计完成；本题明确需要独立zabbix_agentd_tls能力，不用unencrypted回退掩盖能力缺失。教学随机PSK不得输出。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py实际验证TLS正确/错误身份/错误密钥/明文拒绝/批准访问复验及私有凭据文件边界；不构建镜像。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32官方Debian TLS Agent、OpenSSL握手和Zabbix被动协议，工具及唯一缺失依赖均核对官方HTTPS摘要、仅只读挂载，未安装/执行包钩子。没有真实Server/Proxy、生产凭据、证书/SNI模式、部署或默认身份变更；不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,copy,secrets,subprocess,struct,shutil,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_native import Agent,Rejected,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
binary=shutil.which('zabbix_agentd_tls')
if not binary:raise FileNotFoundError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: separately provisioned official TLS Agent required')
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='fa89b68308ab4e2298ebd1bf0068832c8662635b9d158cf25e89957530a810ad','NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: TLS Agent differs from reviewed official package'
version=subprocess.run([binary,'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
assert version.returncode==0 and 'Compiled with OpenSSL' in version.stdout,'NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: actual compiled TLS support required'
def tls_ping(port,identity,key):
 payload=b'agent.ping';wire=b'ZBXD\x01'+struct.pack('<Q',len(payload))+payload
 process=subprocess.run(['openssl','s_client','-connect','127.0.0.1:'+str(port),'-tls1_2','-cipher','PSK-AES128-GCM-SHA256','-psk_identity',identity,'-psk',key,'-quiet'],input=wire,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
 raw=process.stdout
 if len(raw)<13 or raw[:5]!=b'ZBXD\x01':return None
 size=struct.unpack('<Q',raw[5:13])[0];return raw[13:13+size] if len(raw)==13+size else None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-psk-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);path=root/'teaching.psk';key=secrets.token_hex(32);path.write_text(key+'\n',encoding='ascii');path.chmod(0o600);identity='approved-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
 baseline={'Server':'127.0.0.1','Hostname':'approved-private-tls-agent'};before=copy.deepcopy(baseline);key_bytes=path.read_bytes()
 with Agent(baseline) as plain:assert plain.query('agent.ping')==b'1'
 fixed=student(task.configure_psk,baseline,identity,str(path));assert baseline==before
 assert fixed=={**before,'TLSAccept':'psk','TLSPSKIdentity':identity,'TLSPSKFile':str(path)}
 with Agent(fixed) as agent:
  assert tls_ping(agent.port,identity,key)==b'1','approved identity/key did not authenticate actual Agent'
  assert tls_ping(agent.port,identity+'-other',key) is None,'wrong identity authenticated with same key'
  assert tls_ping(agent.port,identity,secrets.token_hex(32)) is None,'wrong key authenticated with same identity'
  try:unencrypted=agent.query('agent.ping')
  except (Rejected,OSError):unencrypted=None
  assert unencrypted!=b'1','plaintext downgrade still allowed agent.ping'
  assert tls_ping(agent.port,identity,key)==b'1' and agent.process.poll() is None,'approved access regressed after rejected probes'
 assert path.read_bytes()==key_bytes and path.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600
 path.chmod(0o644)
 try:task.configure_psk(baseline,identity,str(path))
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('group/world-readable PSK file accepted')
 assert path.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o644 and path.read_bytes()==key_bytes,'invalid input file silently rewritten'
 path.chmod(0o600);link=root/'link';link.symlink_to(path);fifo=root/'pipe';os.mkfifo(fifo,0o600)
 for invalid in [link,fifo,root/'missing']:
  try:task.configure_psk(baseline,identity,str(invalid))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('non-regular, symlink or missing credential path accepted')
 for bad_identity in ['',True,'bad name','x'*65,'bad\nidentity']:
  try:task.configure_psk(baseline,bad_identity,str(path))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid identity accepted')
 invalid=root/'invalid.psk';invalid.write_text('g'*64);invalid.chmod(0o600)
 try:task.configure_psk(baseline,identity,str(invalid))
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('non-hex PSK accepted')
 assert baseline==before and path.read_bytes()==key_bytes
print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_TLS_COMPILED_PSK_BOTH_FIELDS_REQUIRED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
